Ryan Bigg is looking for work

 27 Aug 2026

As of last week, I’ve been working at Fat Zebra for 5 years. (To celebrate, I caught up with my cardiologist.) In about a year and a half, it’ll be double the amount of time that I’ve worked anywhere else. So I think that has to count for something in both Fat Zebra’s favour and my own.

This week I was given some big news:

  1. The powers that be want to restructure my team
  2. This means the Tech Lead of Customer Experience role is now redundant
  3. BUT! I’ve received an offer to go work as an individual contributor in a different, very cool team
  4. Bonus: no pay cut.

Ironically, I was wearing my “This is actually my second rodeo” t-shirt while I received my second ever redundancy offer. But unlike the first time, there’s actually a pretty decent offer on the other end. I can either:

  1. Take the redundancy package and go find another fully-remote job.
  2. Stay at Fat Zebra, and work on things that I’ve not had the chance to yet.

I’ve decided to take the first option. So I’m now going to be looking for my next 5+ year gig.

If you’re hiring a fully-remote, Australian senior / lead developer with a lot of Ruby + JavaScript experience, I’d be happy to have a chat with you. And yeah, it needs to be fully-remote as I live in Warrnambool, 250km from Melbourne. I can travel in a few times a month to an office if/when required.

You can email me@ryanbigg.com, or contact me through LinkedIn. My resume is at /work.
